texts.zh:
我们获悉，我们的宗主投资了相当可观的能量和资源来改善他们的恒星基地工程，以期巨幅提升提升产出能力和潜能。

由于防卫工作是我们两个帝国之间关系的重要基石，我们已经寻求订立协议，以获取一部分的科技，从而对我们其中的一座恒星基地进行相似改进。
texts.en:
We have been informed that our overlord has invested a considerable amount of energy and resources into improving their starbase engineering, improving the output and potential of theirs by leaps and bounds.

As defense is an important keystone in the relationship between our two empires, we have started looking into crafting an agreement where we could request some of their engineers to help improve one of our bases as well.

label.en: Prepare a message to be sent to [overlord_empire.Capital.GetName].

label.zh: 我们还不至于困窘到诉诸乞讨的程度。
label.en: We are not in such dire need that we must resort to begging.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现宗主国首都的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the overlord's capital appears here.

texts.zh:
我们收到了一份来自[subject_empire.Capital.GetName]的信息，信息中表明了[subject_empire.GetName]的一个请求。

似乎他们对投资他们的恒星基地很感兴趣，并且也听说了我们在这方面已取得的进展。他们似乎非常愿意支付一定代价来换取我们的支援。
texts.en:
We have received a messenger directly from [subject_empire.Capital.GetName], with a request from [subject_empire.GetName].

It seems they are interested in investing in their starbases, and have heard about the progress we have made on improving ours. It seems they are quite willing to pay for our assistance in this endeavor.

label.zh: 那就这么办，我们派一些工程师过去。
label.en: Then so be it, let us send some of our engineers.

tooltips.zh: [targeted_starbase.GetName]将会用我们最新的恒星基地科技进行升级。
tooltips.en: [targeted_starbase.GetName] will be upgraded to use our latest starbase technology.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现附庸国的名称。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这座恒星基地的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this starbase appears here.

texts.zh:
就在我们发送信息给[overlord_empire.GetName]之后，工程师们很快就抵达了[targeted_starbase.GetName]。他们几乎立刻调动起了所有当地的人力资源翻建整座恒星基地，并且很快就完成了这个工程。

尽管部分翻建恒星基地的细节仍对我们有所保留，但只要假以时日，我们的工程师一定能进一步理解的。
texts.en:
The engineers arrived at [targeted_starbase.GetName] shortly after we sent our message to [overlord_empire.GetName]. Supposedly they put everyone there into rebuilding the starbase almost immediately, and made short work of the process.

Though some of the details of the restructuring of the starbase still evade us, our engineers hope to understand more, given time.

texts.zh:
就在我们发送信息给[overlord_empire.GetName]之后，[overlord_empire.GetEngineerPlural]们很快就抵达了[targeted_starbase.GetName]。他们几乎立刻调动起了所有需要的一切资源，并且很快就完成了对恒星基地的翻建。

尽管部分翻建恒星基地的细节仍对我们有所保留，但只要假以时日，我们的工程师一定能进一步理解的。
texts.en:
The [overlord_empire.GetEngineerPlural] arrived at [targeted_starbase.GetName] shortly after we sent our messenger to [overlord_empire.GetName]. Supposedly they were quick to organize everything the way they wanted, and the process of refitting the starbase was swiftly done.

Although some of the details of the restructuring of the starbase still evade us, our engineers hope to understand more, given time.

label.zh: 尽管如此我们仍感激不尽。

texts.en: We have received a brusque reply from our overlord, stating that they do not have the time nor any interest in aiding us with our endeavors to improve upon our defenses.

summary.text:
# 一个请求 / A Request

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/overlord_subject_events.txt:361-700`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:521-535`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 宗主国每五年一次的随机脉冲 on_five_year_random_pulse_overlord（00_on_actions.txt:521-535）：无事200，11个事件链各10（subject.1、50、100、1001、1050、1100、2001、2050、2100、3001、3050）；每条链的隐藏派发事件检查冷却标志和条件。
  The overlord's five-year random pulse on_five_year_random_pulse_overlord (00_on_actions.txt:521-535): nothing 200, eleven chains at 10 each (subject.1, 50, 100, 1001, 1050, 1100, 2001, 2050, 2100, 3001, 3050); the hidden dispatcher of each chain checks cooldown flags and conditions.
- 派发 subject.50（隐藏）：宗主国有堡垒型附庸，且某附庸星港等级可升级而宗主国已拥有对应科技、星港尚无该科技、合金储备足够（750/1500/4000）；设置“请求”标志后触发 55。
  Hidden dispatcher subject.50: an overlord with a Bulwark subject whose starbase could be upgraded to a size the overlord has the tech for (and the subject lacks), with enough alloys (750 / 1500 / 4000); it sets a request flag and fires 55.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 55「请求」（附庸）：a 向宗主国发出请求 → 15天后 60「请求」（宗主国）：a 派出工程师 → 150天后 62「升级后的基地」；b 拒绝 → 65「请求被拒」。55.b 放弃。
  55 "A Request" (subject): a send a request -> 60 "A Request" (overlord) 15 days later: a send engineers -> 62 "The Upgraded Base" after 150 days; b refuse -> 65 "Request Denied". 55.b gives up.
- 链上的事件成对发给宗主国和附庸国双方；窗口措辞随玩家扮演的一方而异。
  Events of a chain are sent in pairs to the overlord and the subject; window wording differs for the side the player is on.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 62 与 65 互斥。
  62 and 65 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 请求内容随标志 bulwark_specialist_request_citadel / star_fortress / starhold 而定。
  The request depends on the flags bulwark_specialist_request_citadel / star_fortress / starhold.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：派发条件、请求标志、选项分支。
  Checked: dispatcher conditions, request flags, option branches.
